'''High King''' was the title given to the feudal ruler of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hargeeva]]. During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], [[Makintay]] held the title.<ref name="DM">''{{JournalCite|10|Desperate Measures}}''</ref>
